title: 03802 - B1487/038023
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Automatic Run & Pinch Protection missing Basic Setting
stepByStepSolution: Perform Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  Window Regulator Normalisation (see VAG Grubu Özel Servis ve Kronik Notları)
technicalNotes:
Window Regulator Normalisation'
WARNING: The Basic Setting is performed below and there is a Risk of injury!
The window will move during this procedure, make sure the window area is free and clear of people or objects.
Use the Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  Window Regulator Normalisation, press [Go!]
Wait for the window to stop and the message Finished Correctly should be displayed.
